entries.name: Late Acceptance Hill Climbing
entries.publication: Burke & Bykov (2017), The late acceptance Hill-Climbing heuristic

entries.name: Extended Great Deluge
entries.formula: Accept every improving candidate in addition to candidates satisfying the water-level bound; the time-predefined formulation interprets its controls through search time and expected final quality.
entries.publication: Burke, Bykov, Newall & Petrovic (2003), A Time-Predefined Approach to Course Timetabling

entries.name: Adaptive Flex-Deluge
entries.formula: Flexible Great-Deluge acceptance with run-time adaptation of the acceptance condition, scientifically distinct from the classical one-parameter Dueck water-level controller.
entries.publication: Burke & Bykov (2016), An Adaptive Flex-Deluge Approach to University Exam Timetabling

entries.name: Demon-based budget acceptance
entries.formula: Maintain a non-negative acceptance credit: improving moves replenish credit and a worsening move may spend available credit. This controller is reserved for v0.36.0 so its exact credit semantics are not conflated with Threshold Accepting or Late Acceptance.
entries.publication: Talbi (2009), Metaheuristics: From Design to Implementation, Demon algorithm / acceptance discussion

entries.name: Zimmermann-Salamon Demon Algorithm
entries.formula: The original Demon Algorithm evolves an ensemble of systems through target distributions and collective moves; it is scientifically distinct from the later one-point Demon-like credit acceptance used in local-search hybrids.
